Scoring that puts your job first
So what is Resume scoring?
Resume scoring uses artificial intelligence to evaluate candidate resumes against job-specific criteria. Instead of keyword filters, the AI analyzes each resume for relevant skills and experience, assigning a transparent, comparable score that helps recruiters shortlist candidates faster while reducing bias.
Say goodbye to keyword games. Unlike keyword-based resume screening tools, our AI creates customized scoring criteria based on your job description. This way, each resume is scored on skills and experience the role needs.
A fair, consistent way to screen resumes
Give each and every candidate a fair evaluation with one comparable score based on customizable criteria.
Get to a great shortlist, faster
Our AI scores your entire resume pool in minutes, surfacing your most relevant candidates.
Fair by design, not by accident
Personal details are stripped to reduce bias, and our system is monitored to ensure fair outcomes.

See the reasons behind every 0–5 score, edit the criteria before you start, and override any score.

FAQs
Most ATS filters rely on rigid keyword matching, which can screen out great candidates who have the skills you need but don’t quite meet the keyword criteria. Our Resume scoring starts with your job description to create custom, skills-based criteria. It’s fairer and more effective than keyword matching.
Not at all. We built our Resume scoring for transparency and control. You’re in the driver’s seat: You review and edit the scoring criteria before screening begins and every 0–5 score comes with a clear explanation and is linked to evidence from your job description. You can override any score if you believe the AI missed important context.
Our AI evaluates each resume against the custom criteria you’ve approved for the job.
Criterion score (0–5):
Each resume gets a score from 0–5 for every individual criterion, showing how strongly the candidate’s experience matches that specific requirement. The 5 criterions are equally weighted.
Percentile score:
We convert the candidate’s overall raw score into a percentile. This shows you how their resume compares to thousands of other resumes scored on our platform, giving you a clear benchmark of their strength.
Fairness is at the core of our design. Here’s how we reduce bias:
Anonymous review:
Personal details like names, photos, pronouns, and locations are automatically removed from resumes before scoring.
Job-relevant criteria:
Scoring is based on skills and experience directly related to your job description, not on proxies like years of experience, which research shows have a very low correlation with job performance (r≈0.06).
Continuous monitoring:
Our system is regularly checked by our science team to ensure fair outcomes across demographic groups.
Candidates can upload their resume as a PDF (.pdf) or a Microsoft Word document (.docx). The maximum file size is 2MB.
It only takes a few minutes. You just provide your job description, and our AI instantly generates role-specific scoring criteria. You review and approve these criteria, and you’re ready to start screening.
You have full control. The AI-suggested criteria are a starting point, but you can edit them, replace them with your own, or remove any you don’t need. You always have the final say on what matters before any scoring begins.
The candidate experience is simple and seamless. They just upload their resume when prompted during the assessment. They do not see their score or any of the AI’s reasoning; they only receive a confirmation that their resume has been processed.
It enhances manual review, it doesn’t replace it. Our tool does the heavy lifting by scoring your entire resume pool and surfacing a ranked shortlist. This frees your team from high-volume initial screening, so they can spend quality time with resumes from your most relevant candidates.
Resume scoring is available on all TestGorilla plans, including our Free plan. We believe every company deserves a faster and fairer way to screen resumes.
